purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public cadastral viewer/service review, bounded anonymous access, safe-field handling, and uncertainty.
assessment: The official SNC public viewer currently configures a GeoServer WFS parcel layer. Anonymous capabilities and schema requests succeeded, and a bounded request returned three full parcel geometries with only canonical native ids retained. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, owner, address, titleholder, contact, or unsafe cadastral fields were used.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official SNC public cadastral viewer/WFS and the official municipality directory's Ciudad del Este cooperation record. This does not establish complete or current citywide parcel coverage.
